text:
aj: Heads up — release cutoff in ~6h (18:00 UTC). Please add changelog one-liners, set component tags, and confirm owner for any backports. Use the release notes template: https://go/redwood/release-notes-template :package:

rachael: copy. quick q: do infra/ops-only config tweaks go in this changelog or stay in ops-changes.md?

aj: Put visible user-impacting items in changelog. infra-only config (no user-visible behavior) -> ops-changes.md and link from changelog if necessary.

sam: pinging owners: @kevin for runtime/latency changes, @rachael for release tooling changes. Can you add brief one-liners and mark component? :eyes:

kevin: will add one-liner. also noticed changelog-lint failing on my PR — here's output:
```
ERROR: entry must be <= 120 chars; found 187
ERROR: missing component tag (component: eng-runtime)
```

kevin: question — allowed to reference internal ticket IDs? i.e., 'fix latency (INFR-4321)'

rachael: prefer human-readable: 'reduce token latency for small-batch workloads (internal INFR-4321)'

devops-bot: Reminder — changelog-lint will auto-block merges 30m before cutoff. Run `scripts/changelog-lint --fix` or edit entry.

sam: small clarifying style: start with verb, keep customer-facing tone, avoid 'misc' as a component. Example:
- 'Reduce tail latency for small-batch inference (runtime): improves UI responsiveness for low-traffic tenants.'

aj: if you need rollback instructions included, put them under 'operational notes' in the PR description and add a one-line pointer in the changelog entry.

rachael: can confirm I added the one-liner + component to my PR (link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2789). left a note for backport owner.

kevin: pushed an updated entry, trimmed to 116 chars and added `component: eng-runtime`. lint green. :white_check_mark:

sam: thanks — I'll run a quick sweep 1h before cutoff and ping any missing owners. If anyone is unsure about phrasing DM me.

release-bot: Cutoff in 1h 05m. Good luck! :tada:
